data.value: The host must be a NAME, not an IP address. With an IP, FreeRDP truncates the address at the first dot and Entra rejects the sign-in. Put the IP in the field below instead.

data.value: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535 (RDP uses 3389 by default).

data.name: ErrorUserNotUpn
data.value: The user must be a full UPN, for example you@example.com.

data.name: ErrorVpnInterfaceTooLong
data.value: The VPN interface name may be at most 15 characters (the Linux limit for network names).

data.name: ErrorVpnInterfaceInvalidCharacters
data.value: The VPN interface name may only contain letters, digits, hyphens, underscores and dots.

data.name: ErrorHandshakeTimeoutOutOfRange
data.value: The handshake timeout must be between 5 and 600 seconds.

data.name: ErrorExtraArgsEmpty
data.value: The xfreerdp3 arguments cannot be empty.

data.name: ErrorExtraArgsMissingAadFlag
data.value: The arguments must include /sec:aad — it is the only way in to an Entra-joined machine.
